AnswerScope.description: Whether the ontology may answer directly or only provide filing context.
AnswerScope.title: AnswerScope

EvidenceRequirement.description: Minimum evidence directness required for one question clause.
EvidenceRequirement.title: EvidenceRequirement

PlanUncertainty.description: Agent-reported uncertainty in entity and retrieval planning.
PlanUncertainty.title: PlanUncertainty

QueryClause.description: One independently verifiable part of the user's research question.

calculation_window.description: Required for temporal metric axes. `period_over_period` means adjacent annual or quarter observations; `year_over_year` means the same fiscal/calendar quarter or annual period one year apart. YTD observations only support year_over_year.
calculation_window.title: Calculation Window

clause_id.description: Stable caller-assigned clause id, such as `revenue_driver`.
clause_id.title: Clause Id

directness.description: Minimum evidence directness needed for this clause.

metric_dimensions.description: Explicit segment, geography, product, counterparty, or other dimension values that an exact metric observation must contain.
metric_dimensions.title: Metric Dimensions

metric_scope.description: Required metric observation scope. Use `dimensioned` with explicit metric_dimensions; `any` must be an intentional broad request.
metric_scope.title: Metric Scope

metrics.description: Optional canonical metric names required by this clause.
metrics.title: Metrics

object_types.description: Optional ontology object-type filters selected from index capabilities.
object_types.title: Object Types

required.description: True when the final answer is incomplete without this clause.
required.title: Required

required_concepts.description: Complete set of non-metric concepts that evidence must establish for this clause. Every concept must be named in retrieval_query. Metric and dimension identities may be repeated here, but a metric clause must not mix in a causal, mechanism, risk, or other qualitative proposition; split those into independent clauses so each part is verified separately.
required_concepts.title: Required Concepts

required_predicates.description: Relation or mechanism terms that must occur with all required_concepts inside one traceable claim/quote span. Required for qualitative clauses containing more than one concept; metric clauses cannot use it.
required_predicates.title: Required Predicates

retrieval_query.description: Self-contained retrieval query for this clause. Include the relevant entity, metric, mechanism, and comparison concept instead of conversational filler.
retrieval_query.title: Retrieval Query

tickers.description: Optional ticker subset for this clause. Empty inherits the plan ticker scope; an explicit subset must be contained in SearchPlan.tickers.
tickers.title: Tickers

QueryClause.title: QueryClause

description: Agent-authored, fully validated plan that the MCP server executes as written.

answer_scope.description: Whether ontology evidence may answer directly or only support context.

clauses.description: One to twelve independently verifiable retrieval clauses.
clauses.title: Clauses

comparison_axes.description: Executable comparison dimensions. Numeric axes require an explicit canonical metric in at least one clause.
comparison_axes.title: Comparison Axes

document_types.description: Explicit filing/document type filters, for example `10-K` or `10-Q`.
document_types.title: Document Types

intent.description: Agent-selected intent identifier. Use a stable lowercase slug; the server records it but does not reclassify it with keyword rules.
intent.title: Intent

limit_results.description: Maximum number of deduplicated evidence units returned to the model.
limit_results.title: Limit Results

limit_tickers.description: Maximum ticker candidates considered when discovery is required.
limit_tickers.title: Limit Tickers

periods.description: Explicit period filters, for example `CY2025` or `CY2026Q1`.
periods.title: Periods

question.description: Original user question, preserved for answer synthesis and audit.
question.title: Question

tickers.description: Explicit uppercase ticker scope. Empty means discovery is required.
tickers.title: Tickers

uncertainty.description: Planning uncertainty; higher values keep a wider candidate set.

universe.description: Use `covered` for discovery across the active serving index. Do not combine it with explicit tickers.
universe.title: Universe

title: SearchPlan
